name: firsthearth-cpu-game
note: the self-playing cart: four Normal CPUs, every choice entered by pressing the pad's actions toward the highlighted place, count or option; a full game ends with a legal winner inside the frame budget, and both GPU hosts reach the same state hash and scores. Control: the run one frame short differs

name: firsthearth-idle-seat
note: a CPU (Normal) first and a person who never touches the pad (the how-to-play card still open): the CPU sends its first kin under the card and the game waits for the person. Control: the person sits first instead, the idle seat is to move, and nothing is played (0 decisions)

name: firsthearth-newcomer
note: a newcomer on one pad against CPU Easy, using only what the screen offers: the confirm press the how-to-play card and every prompt name, every 20 frames, which closes the card and then takes the highlighted place, the highlighted number of kin and the highlighted option each time; a full game ends inside the budget (every move legal by construction: the highlights are legal moves). Control: the same presses on the back action, which the prompts offer only to pick another place, so the person never sends a kin and no game ends
